text: This report provides an update to the Board of Health on the Toronto Public Health (TPH) Capital Variance for the six months that ended on June 30, 2025. As of June 30, 2025, Toronto Public Health spent $0.865 million representing 11.7 percent of the 2025 Approved Capital Budget of $7.415 million. At year end, Toronto Public Health's capital expenditures are expected to be $6.847 million representing 92.3 per cent of the 2025 Approved Capital Budget of $7.415 million.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the report (September 4, 2025) from the Acting Medical Officer of Health for information.
